column2: Response TA disables or enables the use of result code +CME ERROR: <err> as an indication of an error relating to the functionality of the ME. OK If error is related to ME functionality: +CME ERROR:<err>

Parameter <n> 0 Disable +CME ERROR: <err> result code and use ERROR instead. 1 Enable +CME ERROR: <err> result code and use numeric <err> 2 Enable +CME ERROR: <err> result code and use verbose <err> values
